free_tier_limits: No official free-tier allowance or GET usage cap is published. Application POST requests are limited to 2 per second.
rate_limits: Application POST requests are limited to 2 per second; exceeding this returns HTTP 429. Lever may change the limit without warning. No numeric limit is documented for listing GET requests.
resolution_notes: free_tier_limits: Corrected; Lever's pricing page offers custom quotes and states no free allowance, while the API docs specify only the POST limit: https://www.lever.co/pricing and https://github.com/lever/postings-api#post-application-rate-limit. rate_limits: Corrected to 2 application POSTs/second; no GET limit is documented: https://github.com/lever/postings-api#post-application-rate-limit. cors: Set to yes, but restricted to the customer's own domains/subdomains: https://github.com/lever/postings-api#introduction.
